2124826050009891301.en_summary: $CRWD $ZS CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $43.9B. The all-stock deal values Zscaler at $260.41 per share, a 34% premium. Key highlights: Combined ARR exceeding $10 billion, $1 billion in expected annual revenue synergies, $500 million in annual cost savings, expands CrowdStrike’s addressable market by $185 billion. Expected to close in H2 FY2028, subject to approvals. The deal will combine endpoint security and Zero Trust network security into one platform.
